description: Design system type rules. All components must reference these type tokens for font family, scale, weight, and line height.

primaryTypeface.usage: Primary typeface for all UI text, headings, and body copy across digital and printed materials.

monoVariant.usage: Code, tokens, and technical values only.

systemFonts.description: Fallback typefaces used when Roboto, Garamond, or Avant Garde are unavailable, particularly in email communications.

fonts.usage: Universal substitute included as a system font on most operating systems.

do: Treat system fonts as fallbacks only — never as the primary design typeface
dont: Do not use system fonts in designed UI components when Roboto is available
Do not mix system fonts with Roboto within the same layout

typeScale.description: Type scale hierarchy for all UI text. Reference by token name.

tokens.usage: Hero and display-level headings. Use sparingly for top-level page statements.
Large body text. Use for lead paragraphs or prominent supporting text.
Default body text for all standard content.
Small body text for secondary or supporting content.
Captions, labels, and fine print. Use sparingly at smallest size.

do: Use Roboto as the primary typeface for all UI components
Reference type tokens by name (e.g. body-default, h2) rather than raw pixel values
Apply heading line height (120%–130%) to all heading tokens
Apply body line height (140%–150%) to all body and caption tokens
Use Roboto Mono exclusively for code, tokens, and technical values
dont: Do not use system fonts (Helvetica, Arial) in UI components — reserve them for email fallback only
Do not apply heading weights to body text or vice versa
Do not use caption (12px) as standard body text — it is for supplementary content only
Do not invent type sizes outside of the defined scale
